blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cebu local government units (LGUs) along major northern and southern highways have been directed to enforce stricter traffic controls and rerouting schemes to ease congestion during Kalag-Kalag. Under Executive Order No. 56, signed by Gov. Pamela Baricuatro on Monday, October 26, all cities and municipalities in the province must implement traffic […]...
